question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
-- Final comprehensive seller performance report
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_products_sold,
        ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_item_price,
        ROUND(AVG(orv.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score,
        ROUND(AVG(
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 3600.0
        ), 2) AS avg_packing_time_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcat.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) AS total_category_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS category_item_count
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        ROUND(SUM(total_category_sales), 2) AS top_category_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_item_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM category_sales
    GROUP BY seller_id, product_category_name_english, category_item_count
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_products_sold,
    sm.avg_item_price,
    sm.avg_review_score,
    sm.avg_packing_time_hours,
    rc.product_category_name_english AS top_category_english,
    rc.top_category_sales
FROM seller_metrics sm
JOIN ranked_categories rc ON sm.seller_id = rc.seller_id AND rc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sm.total_products_sold DESC

-- Final comprehensive seller performance report
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_products_sold,
        ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_item_price,
        ROUND(AVG(orv.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score,
        ROUND(AVG(
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 3600.0
        ), 2) AS avg_packing_time_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcat.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) AS total_category_sales,
        COUNT(*) AS category_item_count
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english,
        ROUND(SUM(total_category_sales), 2) AS top_category_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_item_count DESC) AS rn
    FROM category_sales
    GROUP BY seller_id, product_category_name_english, category_item_count
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_products_sold,
    sm.avg_item_price,
    sm.avg_review_score,
    sm.avg_packing_time_hours,
    rc.product_category_name_english AS top_category_english,
    rc.top_category_sales
FROM seller_metrics sm
JOIN ranked_categories rc ON sm.seller_id = rc.seller_id AND rc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sm.total_products_sold DESC
